comment: Production Cloud SQL consumers owned by the orca-cloud application tree. The relay tree ships without apps/auth and apps/api, so the values it needs for the connection budget are published here instead of parsed out of application source. dev/scripts/production-cloud-sql-app-consumers.test.mjs binds every field back to its source with the regexes the budget script used, so application-side drift fails application-side CI.

sources.apiInstances: infra/terraform-apps/environments/production.tfvars: max_instances (the artifact API service; the first max_instances not prefixed auth_)
sources.maxConnections: Tier default for google_sql_database_instance.auth; infra/terraform-foundation/database.tf declares no max_connections database flag that would override it
